decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample displacement in N/E around indices 489–492 within the overlapping window [485,664], possibly indicating a transient offset or jump with ambiguous recovery; (2) a very abrupt, large cross-axis shift at indices 607–608 in the [605,729] window, followed by a plateau and potential partial reversal—warranting closer inspection due to its magnitude and timing relative to missing samples.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample jump in N and E (N from ~0.5 to ~2.2, E from ~-1.8 to ~-0.9) around index 489–492, followed by a sustained offset; U shows less coherent change but a possible opposing return starting near 493.

Abrupt large shift in E (~-2.8 to ~0.1) and N (~-1.3 to ~0.1) at index 607–608, with missing samples at 609–610; subsequent samples show a platform-like behavior in E/N until ~620, then a possible partial return or new offset.
